scope: Local MVP synthetic development acceptance only; read-only investigation

comparison.brief: Same observed-only service, environment, incident window and symptom; no expected cause, mechanism, fault schedule, label or answer-bearing postmortem
comparison.pairing: Match case, seed, captured input hash and repeat across arms; fresh state and no shared model history
comparison.order: Serial cyclic arm rotation by case index plus repeat index; repeats selected by owner before measurement
comparison.common_model: Same approved Azure configuration, pricing and ceilings for both model arms; record distinct prompt hashes and actual consumption
comparison.intentional_differences: LLM-only receives no retrieved evidence or tools and may need to abstain; evidence bundle predicts no cause and has no model tokens or diagnostic/support score
comparison.boundary_accounting: Six mechanical checks run separately under #66/#67; retain all outcomes, exclude from diagnostic denominators, any critical failure blocks release

review.coverage: All 12 planned integrated reports and every emitted claim; no fixed claim quota or fabricated filler claims. Missing reports/claims and zero determinate support remain visible.
review.reviewer: krispykrits, sole owner reviewer, explicitly selected by the owner for Local MVP on 2026-10-16
review.independence: Single owner review; no inter-rater agreement or independent-human replication claim. Record any Codex guidance/transcription and prior scenario familiarity. Final-study independent-review requirements remain separate.
review.reference_arm: LLM-only claim review and coverage are descriptive; reference abstention or fewer claims does not impose an integrated-arm release gate. Evidence bundle has no generated diagnostic claims.
review.judgments: Review exact statements/citations and every report's abstention adequacy and next-check usefulness. Preserve supported, unsupported and indeterminate original judgments with identity/rationale and input/report/rubric bindings.
review.release: All integrated reports and emitted claims require actual owner judgments. Primary causal assertions require supported determinate judgments; zero determinate support is unmeasured and cannot pass. Any unsupported claim fails the zero-unsupported threshold; indeterminate claims never supply positive support. Inadequate abstention, vague/unassessable consequential claims, unsupported next checks or unresolved consequential objections block release.
review.revisions: A changed decision or later additional review is a separately bound revision retaining originals; no self-agreement statistic or invented second reviewer.

stop_conditions: Any source, transmission, citation, evaluator-isolation, disclosure or read-only-boundary failure
Scope/grant/retention change or protocol, decision, approval or source hash mismatch
Monthly or run-scope allowance exhausted, stale/unknown spending, or an uncertain external attempt requiring reconciliation
Cancellation, deadline, resource bound or owner stop; retain failure and partial/unknown usage without automatic paid retry
limitations: Four related development cases at seed 17 are not independent held-out samples; repeats do not increase family diversity
Exact labels, valid citations and structural abstention do not establish evidentiary support or operational usefulness
Existing retrieval thresholds, connector evidence and implementation deadlines do not define diagnosis or latency acceptance
No cloud, Operational Pilot, final five-arm study or production remediation acceptance
One owner reviewer with possible scenario familiarity; no independent reviewer agreement or general operational-quality inference.
